title: Timothy-grass feed properties and pre-ensiling press-liquid composition and capture
source_title: Chemical Characterisation and Biorefinery Efficiency of Timothy Grass and Pulp Silages
evidence_class: peer-reviewed primary experimental measurements and source-reported component-capture values
geography: Finland; cultivated timothy grass from primary growth and first regrowth
feedstock: Cultivated timothy grass; not Dutch roadside grass
scope: Table 1 pre-ensiling feed properties for primary-growth intact and pulp and first-regrowth intact, pulp, and wilted material.
Table 5 pre-ensiling liquid yield, dry matter, pH, composition, source-reported capture, macro-minerals and trace minerals.
First-regrowth intact liquid results from pilot single-screw and double-screw pressing remain separate.
measurement_basis: The CSV preserves the source's reported units and basis labels. No conversion, interpolation, aggregation, or balance closure is performed.

process_conditions.primary_growth_pilot_single_screw: The article reports a 2.2 kW drive, 24 rpm, 800 kg biomass/h nominal capacity and 0.75 mm filter mesh. Primary-growth intact grass at 276 g DM/kg fresh matter was circulated three to four times; 0.4 L water/kg fresh grass was added during the first and second cycles.
process_conditions.other_conditions: Press and treatment labels are preserved from Table 5; settings not stated for the other press configurations are not inferred.

limitations: Cultivated Finnish timothy is a comparator, not roadside grass or GreenHub feed.
Table values are transcribed as printed; row-level uncertainty and replicate counts are not supplied in Tables 1 and 5 and remain blank.
For the high-DM primary-growth condition, added water is reported, but its inclusion in the table's fresh-sample liquid-yield denominator is unresolved.
The reported g/g original-material capture values are preserved without conversion or independent recalculation.
Table 5 liquid dry matter is shown as g/kg in the liquid-composition section; the table does not restate a more specific denominator phrase.
The underlying research data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; this extract contains only the published Table 1 and Table 5 values.
runtime_policy: reference_only; not connected to the parameter registry, model defaults, runtime calculations, UI defaults, or Pareto scenarios
access_protocol: HTTPS DOI and institutional repository PDF
